x4 = uppermost(x1) row of green
x5 = leftmost(x1) col of green

x6 = astuple(x2, x4) = (red_row, green_row)
x7 = min = min(red_row, green_row)
x8 = max = max(red_row, green_row)
x9 = (x7, x5) = (min row, green_col)
x10 = (x8, x5) = (max row, green_col)
x11 = connect(x9, x10): vertical line at green column between min and max rows.
x12 = (x3, x5) = (red_col, green_col)
x13 = min, x14 = max
x15 = (x2, x13) = (red_row, min col)
x16 = (x2, x14) = (red_row, max col)
x17 = connect(x15,x16): horizontal line at red row between red col and green col.
x18 = combine(x11,x17)
x19 = underfill(I, 8, x18)

So output draws vertical segment at green column spanning rows from min(red_row,green_row) to max, and horizontal segment at red row spanning cols min(red_col,green_col) to max. They cross at (red_row, green_col). Actually vertical at green col from min to max includes red_row. Horizontal at red_row from min col to max includes green_col. So an L-shape: from green goes vertical to red row, then horizontal to red. Wait if green row > red row: vertical goes up from green to red row; horizontal goes from red to green col. Road travels up/down from green and left/right from red until meet at corner (red_row, green_col).

So output: fill 8 on those segments, preserving 2,3.
